original: 〃 〇一〇〇 N一九-二一 E一一五-五〇 栗 日東丸敵潜ノ雷撃ヲ受ケ沈没
translation: (4th) 0100, N 19°21′ E 115°50′, from Kuri: Nitto Maru torpedoed by an enemy submarine and sunk
note: 2nd China Expeditionary Fleet war diary, July 1944, enemy-submarine table (別図参照), read right to left; each position written vertically, N column then E column, in kanji numerals. Zone not stated; taken as I (Tokyo time), assumed. Reported by the destroyer Kuri (栗). The convoy is not named in this table

original: 〃 一三四五 N二〇-一八 E一一五-〇二 栗 暁勇丸 第二八共同丸 雷撃ヲ受ケ沈没
translation: (4th) 1345, N 20°18′ E 115°02′, from Kuri: Gyoyu Maru and No. 28 Kyodo Maru torpedoed and sunk
note: 2nd China Expeditionary Fleet war diary, July 1944, enemy-submarine table (別図参照), read right to left; each position written vertically, N column then E column, in kanji numerals. Zone not stated; taken as I (Tokyo time), assumed. 暁勇丸 romanized Gyoyu Maru as in the secondary lists (uboat.net). Reported by Kuri
